title: WooCommerce Order
description: A WooCommerce customer order created via the storefront, checkout API, or REST API. Orders track the complete lifecycle of a purchase from cart submission through payment, fulfillment, and optional refunds. Monetary amounts are represented as decimal strings with two decimal places.

id.description: Order unique identifier assigned by WooCommerce.

parent_id.description: Parent order ID. Used for refund orders and child orders.

number.description: Order number displayed to customers on confirmation pages and emails.

order_key.description: Unique key used to verify order ownership in public-facing URLs.

created_via.description: How the order was created (e.g. checkout, rest-api, admin).

version.description: WooCommerce version when the order was created.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code used for the order (e.g. USD, GBP, EUR).

date_created.description: Date the order was created in site timezone (ISO8601 format).

date_created_gmt.description: Date the order was created in UTC (ISO8601 format).

date_modified.description: Date the order was last modified in site timezone.

date_modified_gmt.description: Date the order was last modified in UTC.

date_completed.description: Date the order was marked as completed. Null if not completed.

date_paid.description: Date the order was paid. Null if not paid.

discount_total.description: Total discount amount applied by coupons, as a decimal string.

discount_tax.description: Tax amount on discounts as a decimal string.

shipping_total.description: Total shipping cost as a decimal string.

shipping_tax.description: Tax on shipping cost as a decimal string.

cart_tax.description: Total cart item taxes before shipping as a decimal string.

total.description: Grand total including taxes and shipping as a decimal string.

total_tax.description: Total tax amount as a decimal string.

prices_include_tax.description: Whether the store's product prices include tax.

customer_id.description: Customer ID associated with this order. 0 for guest orders.

customer_ip_address.description: Customer IP address at time of order placement.

customer_user_agent.description: Customer browser user agent string at time of order placement.

customer_note.description: Note entered by the customer at checkout.

payment_method.description: Payment method ID (e.g. stripe, paypal, bacs).

payment_method_title.description: Human-readable payment method name shown to the customer.

transaction_id.description: Unique transaction ID from the payment gateway.

payment_url.description: URL for the customer to complete pending payment.

tax_lines.description: Tax lines applied to the order.

shipping_lines.description: Shipping methods applied to the order.

fee_lines.description: Extra fees applied to the order.

meta_data.description: Custom metadata key-value pairs attached to the order.

Address.description: A postal address used for billing or shipping.

value.description: Metadata value. May be a string, number, or object depending on the key.

LineItem.description: A product purchased as part of an order.

name.description: Product name at the time of purchase.

variation_id.description: ID of the product variation. 0 for simple products.

tax_class.description: Tax class slug applied to this line item.

subtotal.description: Line item subtotal before discounts as a decimal string.

subtotal_tax.description: Subtotal tax as a decimal string.

total.description: Line item total after discounts as a decimal string.

total_tax.description: Total tax for the line item as a decimal string.

taxes.description: Tax breakdown per rate for this line item.

sku.description: Product SKU at time of purchase.

price.description: Unit price of the product at time of purchase.

meta_data.description: Custom metadata for the line item (e.g. selected variation attributes).

TaxLine.description: A tax rate line applied to the order.

compound.description: Whether this is a compound tax rate.

tax_total.description: Tax amount on cart items for this rate.

shipping_tax_total.description: Tax amount on shipping for this rate.

ShippingLine.description: A shipping method applied to the order.

total.description: Shipping cost as a decimal string.

total_tax.description: Shipping tax as a decimal string.

FeeLine.description: An additional fee applied to the order.

tax_class.description: Tax class applied to this fee.

tax_status.description: Whether the fee is taxable. Options: taxable, none.

total.description: Fee amount as a decimal string.

total_tax.description: Tax on the fee as a decimal string.

CouponLine.description: A coupon applied to the order.

discount.description: Discount amount applied by this coupon.

OrderRefundSummary.description: A summary of a refund associated with the order.

total.description: Refund amount as a negative decimal string.
